description: The same engine whose every state-child tag names a declared variant. Isolates tag-membership from the state-child form.
rationale: §51.0.B — an engine's state-children are tagged by VARIANT: `<Idle>` is the arm rendered while the engine sits in `.Idle`. A tag naming no declared variant describes an arm that can never be entered, which is a typo in every realistic case and dead markup in the rest.
